evidence.actual: The user is not assigned to this application.

output.fix: The IdP refused the request because the user isn't assigned to the application. Assign the user, or a group they belong to, to this SP's app in the IdP, then retry the login. Don't loosen any SP-side validation. The Issuer, Destination and InResponseTo checks all passed, so the SP configuration is not the cause. The response has no assertion, so the signature, audience and attribute checks were skipped. Re-run the validation on the next response to check them.

alternatives.why_not: The IdP did refuse, but it returned an explicit non-Success SAML status. SAML_STATUS_NOT_SUCCESS is the more specific class.
